target_customer: Commercial and government satellite operators running large constellations
problem: Ground-based orchestration breaks down as constellations scale from hundreds to tens of thousands of nodes, and reactive monitoring cannot keep up.
business_model: B2B software platform with forward-deployed engineers and a 30-day shadow pilot
product_category: AI operating system for satellite networks

founders.name: Kamran Majid
founders.background_notes: YC page lists ex SpaceX, NASA; education not listed

founders.name: Laith Altarabishi
founders.background_notes: YC page: building AI for satellite mission assurance

founders.name: Raaid Kabir
founders.background_notes: YC page lists previously at Blue Origin

competitors.name: Aalyria
competitors.what: Spacetime network orchestration platform for space and terrestrial networks
competitors.traction_then: Telesat plans to integrate Spacetime into its Lightspeed LEO system
competitors.funding_then: 100M USD Series B at a reported 1.3B USD valuation (2026 coverage)

competitors.name: Kepler Communications
competitors.what: Optical data relay network with IP mesh routing, operator not software vendor
competitors.traction_then: Commercial service after first tranche launched January 2026

technical_complexity.rationale: Real-time telemetry ingest, link prediction and autonomous routing for satellites need domain expertise and integration with ground networks.

defensibility.rationale: Integration with operator mission control creates stickiness, but a far better funded orchestration incumbent exists.

market_need_then: Constellations were scaling quickly and operators faced operational complexity, and Aalyria raised 100M USD for orchestration, showing spend.

branding.domain_note: Uses constellation.space, a descriptive TLD domain. A different contact domain constellation-io.com appears in the YC description.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident, short punchy lines such as Optimize. Automate. Execute., by operators for operators

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with many space and tech firms, such as Constellation Technologies and Operations. No brand press.

outcome_analysis: Constellation Space is an active W26 company with no exit, shutdown or layoffs found. Founders with SpaceX, NASA and Blue Origin experience give founder market fit and it is in a design partner phase. Aalyria, a heavily funded competitor, is the main threat.
notes: Funding: aggregators and a YC adjacent summary report a 6.5M USD seed in March 2026 led by SGH Capital, while Caplight says 7M and Simplify says 130K, so the sources conflict.
